meta.reference_skeleton: Pro_Melee_Axe_Pack/X Bot.fbx (65 bones, hips rest 1.0427 m)
meta.units: metres, seconds, frames are 1-based at the clip fps
meta.axes: model forward = -Y world (rest toe direction); right = -X world; travel/reach use these model axes

fields.hips.travel_fwd/right: hips start->end horizontal displacement on model axes (root motion)
fields.hips.z_min/z_max/z_range: hips world height range over the clip
fields.hips.start_hips_yaw_vs_model_deg: hips facing at frame 1 vs model forward (side-on stances ~ -50..-58)
fields.effectors.*.peak_speed: peak speed of that end-effector RELATIVE TO HIPS (m/s) and its frame
fields.hits: automatic strike candidates (peak speed, then contact = first frame extension stops or speed < 50%); a lead only - see hit_parade.contact_frames for render-judged contacts
fields.loop_pose_err_deg: max body-bone orientation difference first vs last frame (small = loops cleanly)
fields.location_varying_bones: bones whose translation fcurves vary (>0.01 cm); every clip carries 195 location fcurves
fields.rest_rot_maxdiff_vs_xbot: clip armature bind vs X Bot.fbx bind (0.0169 on RightHandThumb3 for all 610 X Bot clips)
fields.hand_distance_m: min/median/max distance between hand bones over the clip (rendered clips only); 2H weapon grip keeps it < 0.25 m
fields.hit_parade: curated move proposal + render-judged contact frames + contact_measure (reach/side/height at contact, model axes)
